title: Coordinate increment of an emitter state
statement: Let an emitter state have three natural-number coordinates, written as a vector $v=(z,a,b)$, and let $t\in\{0,1,2\}$. If the state is advanced in phase $\phi$ at coordinate $t$, its coordinate vector is obtained from $v$ by replacing the $t$th coordinate with $v_t+1$ and leaving the other coordinates unchanged.
